composed_for.brief:
Internal flow through a Venturi flow-meter body - 470.05 mm bore contracting to a 260.34 mm throat (area ratio 3.26) and diffusing back at 10.45 degrees included angle. I want the flow and pressure drop.

Geometry is in millimetres. The overall bounding box is 3287.63 x 507.25 x 507.25 mm (X x Y x Z).

Body surface: the STEP contains the closed wall - carve the fluid cavity INSIDE it. Put the seed point inside the bore just downstream of the inlet, at (369.96, 0, 0) mm. There is no far-field box.
Engine: snappyHexMesh.
Patches: inlet is the circular opening at (0, 0, 0) mm on the X=0 plane, bore diameter 470.05 mm (flow enters along +X); outlet is the circular opening at (3287.63, 0, 0) mm on the X=3287.63 plane, bore diameter 470.05 mm (flow exits along +X). All remaining surfaces are the wall. Fixed pressure outlets at 0 Pa gauge.
Near-wall: Wall-function approach, y+ 30-300, first layer sized for y+ 50-100. Water at 20 C, inlet velocity 2 m/s. 5 prism layers, expansion ratio 1.2.
Refinement: finer at junctions, bends and area changes than on straight runs.
Mesh budget: keep the total cell count under 2 million cells.
Steady state, incompressible, isothermal.

basis: bore = 2 sqrt(inlet opening area / pi) from the declared inlet (drivers.py:422-438, :498-499)
pad max(2 base, 0.03 extent), divisions [46, 10, 10] clamped 8..120, background cell 82.02, deficit 0 (snappy_runner.py:619-634)

wall area = (surface area minus ring faces) / 2, the shell's inner skin; cavity volume = wall area x inlet hydraulic diameter 469.7 / 4 (a passage's V/A is D_h/4 for any section): agent-side assumptions, the renderer carves the cavity it finds
near band: volume within near_dist 263 of the wall (min of wall area x near_dist and the fluid volume) at level 3 (snappy_runner.py:637-638, :681)
beyond the band: 3 cells per level down to the background (nCellsBetweenLevels 3, snappy_runner.py:679), the rest at the background cell
layers: 6 x wall area / wall cell squared, wall cell = level 3 cell (addLayersControls, snappy_runner.py:685-686)
port faces at level 1, one below the wall (snappy_runner.py:636, :666): no cells added, the mouth's cap is coarser than its rim
correction x1 for carve: calibration multiplier 1.01 was fitted against 'median over learning records of delivered cells / standard-tier estima', not the builder emulator; 1.0 applied
held_notes: first cell clamped: first_layer_rel 0.1258 is outside the planner's band 0.2 to 0.4, so the builder's first cell is 1.573 where the plan sized 0.9895 and the delivered y+ is 1.59x the target

payload.write_up:
MEASURED: wall_shell, 2 openings, unit mm (occ_transfer).
CONFIRMED by the customer: role:o1 = inlet; role:o2 = outlet.

MESH PLAN (snappy internal): forecast 716,244 cells of your 2,000,000 cap.
cells_across_diameter 24; surface_level 2; feature_level 3; n_layers 6; first_layer_rel 0.2; quality balanced; max_cells 716244
first_layer_rel 0.2: the outer layer over the wall cell; your y+ asks 0.1258, outside the planner band 0.2 to 0.4, so the first cell lands at 1.59x the one sized.
cells_across_diameter 24: inlet o1 bore 469.7 mm, wall cell 19.57 mm; the smallest port o1 spans 24.0 of them, floor 8.
IF the critique says CARVE LEAKED: cells_across_diameter 32, The thinnest feature the carve has to seal measures 18.26, 0.93 wall cells at cells_across.

mesh_warnings.why: The thinnest feature the carve has to seal measures 18.26, 0.93 wall cells at cells_across_diameter 24 and 1.24 at 32. The classifier's CARVE LEAKED repair asks for a larger domain_margin (judge.py:42-48); render_internal_case reads no domain_margin and pads by max(2 base_cell, 0.03 maxext) (snappy_runner.py:619), so on this path cells_across_diameter is the key that changes the surface that seals: 32 forecasts 1,521,981 cells of the 2,000,000 cap.

provenance.derivation: seed_point: catalog.seed_point_for (inlet centroid plus SEED_INSET_OVER_BORE bores along the inward normal), hexera.seed_check by ray parity over the nesting directions; scored against wall_faces_zero_or_leak once a harness bundle carries it (docs/learning_loop.md 3)

mesh_warnings.why: The carve seed (snappy's locationInMesh) is 0.4 bores inside the inlet o1 along its inward normal. Ray parity was not run here (no mesh file on disk); the handover's seed_check runs it. The platform's own hollow-wall fallback walks the inlet-to-outlet chord, which on a bend is the air between the legs (21 seedfix reruns in the export).

object.simulation_intent: internal flow: inlet to outlet(s), wall-bounded

evidence: every surface that is not a declared port
patches.name: walls

questions.text: If o2 is an outlet, the flow leaving through it has had 1.7 diameters since a change in cross-section, short of the 5 diameters it takes to settle. The mouth is within 5 percent of the declared inlet's area. A pressure outlet holds one static pressure across the whole face and treats the profile there as settled and parallel; this close to the feature neither is measured to be true, so the pressure drop and the flow split reported at o2 are read off a face the flow has not settled on. Bringing the run at o2 to at least 5 diameters means a straight length of 2533 mm where the part has 782.8 today; nothing in the run can add it, so that is a change to the model and a second file, and it is what makes the pressure drop and the flow split at this end worth quoting. If flow enters at o2 rather than leaving, saying so moves the condition to the far end and there is nothing to add. Meshing the part as it stands gets you a mesh today, and the numbers at o2 are the ones not to quote.

risks.consequence: The file is the solid wall of the passage with open ring ports: the mesher carves the fluid cavity inside it from a seed point, the ring bores are the ports.
risks.derivation: catalog: wall_shell_to_carve asks no user decision; carried as the catalog measured it
risks.recommendation: Declare each port by its bore (or annulus area), put the seed point inside the cavity just inside the inlet, and mesh the wall's inner surface as the wall patch.

risks.consequence: Inlet o1 reaches a change in cross-section after 1.8 diameters. A uniform inlet profile has no room to develop before it matters.
risks.derivation: catalog: short_inlet_run asks no user decision; carried as the catalog measured it
risks.recommendation: Prescribe a developed profile at the inlet, or extend the inlet run.
